facts.value: Under the umbrella of the student service, students of the Department of Economics can receive support and advice regarding various questions about their studies.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The E! Week with its mentoring program is the ideal start for all bachelor's students. In a three-day program, first-semester students get to know Goethe University, the department, campus life, and the city of Frankfurt.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Our master's students are warmly welcomed at the Master Welcome Day and receive important information.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The aim of the event series 'Bachelor meets Business' is to create a forum for exchange between science and practice. It invites an exciting selection of companies each winter semester. Master's students are also welcome!
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Our Dean’s List aims to honor outstanding academic achievements and simultaneously bring students and companies into conversation. This special honor from the dean is awarded each semester to the best bachelor’s and master’s students.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: All bachelor’s and master’s graduates receive an invitation to the graduation celebration, where the degree is traditionally celebrated with gowns.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
